name: How can I tell if the discoloration around my window is mold or just dirt?

mainEntity.name: How can I tell if the discoloration around my window is mold or just dirt?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mold often appears as fuzzy, slimy, or discolored patches (black, green, brown, or white) on surfaces. Unlike dirt, mold tends to grow in irregular patterns and may have a musty odor. If you suspect mold, try gently dabbing the area with a cotton swab dipped in bleach; if the color lightens or disappears, it's likely mold. For confirmation, especially if the area is large or difficult to access, professional inspection is recommended.
acceptedAnswer.description: Mold is usually fuzzy, slimy, or discolored with a musty odor, unlike dirt. A bleach test can help identify it, but professional inspection offers certainty.
